verdict.rationale: The only residency-relevant evidence is community reports that GitLab ships a self-managed edition users run on their own infrastructure, which implicitly lets them control where data lives. No first-party documentation covers region selection or data-residency options for GitLab.com, and the mention of Asian and European data centers is about latency, not a user-selectable residency control. Missing for 10: first-party docs on data residency or region selection, a documented choice of storage region for the hosted SaaS, and residency guarantees or compliance details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
